rationale: Figure 1 visibly shows the BIOREASON multimodal input interface: raw DNA sequences, a frozen Evo2 encoder, learnable linear projection, Qwen3 tokenizer/embeddings, special DNA tokens, and stacked DNA+text embeddings fed into Qwen3. This is direct evidence for the DNA-sequence and text-query routes, and the same grounding pattern applies to the coding variant routes shown in the architecture schematic.
